subject: "Something went wrong with Daniel's understanding" error

messages.author: 15280b836cfcd1eb
messages.subject: "Something went wrong with Daniel's understanding" error
parts:
Hello, 

I have a working IPM written in Nimble where the prior for adult survival is set as 

S2 ~ dunif(0.9, 1)

I wanted to change this to be slightly more informative, so I used a scaled beta distribution:

dS ~ dbeta(shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)
S2 <- 0.9 + (0.1*dS)

I set an initial value for dS of 0.5, and removed the initial value set for S2, and am able to compile the model with nimbleModel(). However, when I run nimbleMCMC, I get the error message:

Error in cc_expandDetermNodesInExpr(model, expr[[i]], targetNode, skipExpansionsNode) :
  something went wrong with Daniel's understanding of newNimbleModel #1

I think the error is coming from this function:  https://rdrr.io/cran/nimble/src/R/MCMC_conjugacy.R#sym-cc_expandDetermNodesInExpr but I don't know why. 

Any ideas?

Thanks for your help!

Cheers, 

Eiren
